en.headline: Labour chief says new childcare places will target infants under two
en.dek: Chris Sun said subsidised standalone child care centre places should nearly double by the end of 2029, with extra capacity aimed at the 0-to-2 age group.
body: Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said Hong Kong should spread childcare support across districts so working parents can choose places near home or work, and that new subsidised capacity should focus on infants aged from birth to two.

Speaking in a joint Wen Wei Po and RTHK interview for the programme Hong Kong and the 15th Five-Year Plan, Sun said there are 21 aided standalone child care centres providing more than 1,500 places. The government expects to add about 1,500 places by the end of 2029, almost doubling the current total.

He said demand exists across standalone centres but is greatest for the youngest children, and that new centres would as far as possible serve that age group. The bureau also plans to expand community child-minding and after-school care for working families.
Sun said workplace-based nursery partnerships with employers can work in some cases but have limits, and that a citywide mix of options was a more practical way to support parents.

zh.headline: 孫玉菴：新增幼兒中心名額將集中0至2歲
zh.dek: 勞福局長表示，資助獨立幼兒中心名額料於2029年底前增加約1,500個、接近翻倍，新增資源會盡量投放在0至2歲嬰幼兒。
body: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菴表示，香港支援育兒應「遍地開花」，讓在職家長可按住所或工作地點選擇託育服務，而新增資助名額應集中於0歲至2歲嬰幼兒。
他接受《文匯報》與港台聯合節目《港好十五五》訪問時說，全港現有21所資助獨立幼兒中心，提供超過1,500個名額。政府預計2029年底前可陸續額外提供約1,500個名額，總規模較現時增加接近一倍。
孫玉菴指，獨立幼兒中心整體都有需求，但最大需求落在0歲至2歲，新中心會盡可能針對這個年齡層。當局亦計劃擴大社區幼兒照顧及課後託管，加強支援在職家庭。
他認為企業與機構合辦幼兒學校雖有成功例子，但亦有限制，在全港提供多元選擇較為實際。
